# R4.10 — BL-34 package: ADR-0211 evolution deferrals D-1…D-6 + OQ-461/462/463 — entry-test readings + final proposed dispositions

Spec: `docs/tickets/159_R4.10__bl34-adr-0211-package.md` (seq 159, Round-4
row 24/50). Depends on R4.9 (stacked; base `svitali/harnessharness-r4.9` @
`9982e8d`). Requirement ids: **BL-34** · **ADR-0211** · **OQ-461** ·
**OQ-462** · **OQ-463**. Offline-only; no live legs; docs/records only —
no code, no new dependencies, no behaviour to test.

## Summary

The six ADR-0211 entry tests were evaluated **verbatim** against landed
state (base `9982e8d`). **All six fail** — per the contract, a deferral
whose entry test fails is a natural `descope-by-ADR` (permanently out of
launch scope, the re-entry test preserved verbatim as the future trigger).
The three OQ cells were read; every in-scope id received exactly one FINAL
proposed disposition in
`docs/build/planning/round4-bl34-adr-0211-briefs.md` (the R4.8 brief
convention: batch-adoptable table + `Operator act: "adopt all except:
<ids>"`). **This ticket rules nothing** — every row is a GATE-G7 proposal;
no recording act applied (no GATE DECISIONS row or landed ADR fully
determines these cells).

### Entry-test readings (per-id evidence)

- **D-1** `PrincipalDirectory` — `grep` hits research/spec text only; no
  class contract or proposing ADR. Interim landed
  (`hh-fleet/src/lib.rs` doc header; `engine.rs:101-104` TRANSFER_BASES;
  ABI read-only `abi.rs:18-24`). **FAIL.**
- **D-2** tenant `readers` partition — `readers` is the annotation-row
  field only (`payloads.rs:535`, `engine.rs:2359`); `cross_fleet` refused;
  no sharding/migration ruling. **FAIL.**
- **D-3** pricing rule + `ComparisonReport{artifact_benefit}` — counter
  registered (`hh-ontology/dimensions.rs:76,115`), ceiling enforced
  (`hh-fleet/engine.rs:1301-1361`); `lab/org-policy-v1` recipe landed
  (`exemplars.rs:4210`) but no pricing arm/report; one consumer. **FAIL.**
- **D-4** `SchedulingPolicy.order`-binding variant at `matched_total` —
  variants `static`/`uniform`/`rules` landed (`compute.rs:1425-1427`);
  `FleetSpec` carries no scheduling member; dispatch is the `item_id`
  fold (`engine.rs:1061`); no evaluation/`ComparisonReport`. **FAIL.**
- **D-5** AC-L8-06 with the mirroring procedure's effects — the
  accountability record exists (`engine.rs:2949-3014`); the tracker ABI
  has no write op (`abi.rs:18-24`, `tracker.rs:23-33`); no
  principal-issued writer. **FAIL.**
- **D-6** cross-activation `OwnershipRecord` + topology arm — the recipe
  landed intra-run (`hh-orchestrator/coordination.rs:104-119`,
  `tests/s4_8.rs`); ownership stays per object within one activation
  (ADR-0191); OQ-431 escrow stays `deferred(ADR-0215)`. **FAIL.**
